content.text:
I submitted **index 3 (Sb fraction 0.30)** as the best composition. Its EQE of 0.029% was the highest of the five I measured, but there are about 29 compositions on the line and I can't be sure this is the true peak.

All five EQE measurements are used. I didn't use any of the five XRD measurements, so I have no structural data on why this composition does best.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.19 | −0.016 |
| **3** | **0.30** | **0.029** |
| 4 | 0.36 | 0.025 |
| 12 | 0.50 | 0.005 |
| 22 | 0.67 | 0.007 |

- **Where the peak probably is:** EQE is highest in the Pb-rich range, around Sb 0.28–0.36. It turns negative at 0.19 and drops to about 0.006% at the two compounds listed in the database (Pb₂Sb₂O₇ at 0.50 and PbSb₂O₆ at 0.67).
- **What I didn't test:** index 2 (Sb 0.27) and indices 5–11 (Sb 0.38–0.49) were never measured. The peak could lie between my points, so the true best might be slightly better than index 3.
